purpose: Deterministic, verify-only preflight of a caller-pasted Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) request against a caller-pasted set of ucp.request_constraints values, per the Request Constraints section of the 2026-08-25 overview (tag v2026-08-25 of github.com/Universal-Commerce-Protocol/ucp, Apache-2.0). Evaluates the closed constraint grammar (required, properties, anyOf, enum, const) against every object each value's path selects; an omitted path falls back to the caller-supplied Normalized Path of the object that held ucp. Paths are evaluated with a minimal inline RFC 9535 subset: root, child member, index, wildcard, and equality filters joined by &&, which covers every path in the spec's own examples; anything else is INDETERMINATE with UNSUPPORTED_PATH, never a guess. Verdict SATISFIED, VIOLATED or INDETERMINATE, listing each violated constraint with its path and reason. A malformed value (including an empty or path-carrying anyOf branch) is CONSTRAINT_MALFORMED, a value whose path selects a non-object is skipped, and contradictory const or enum constraints on one object are reported as CONSTRAINT_CONTRADICTION (an authoring error, verdict INDETERMINATE). A missing constraints set means nothing to check. Input size and depth are bounded and over-bound input is INDETERMINATE. Declared exclusions: the resolved request schema is not checked, Business runtime outcomes are not modelled, and the node never fetches a profile, a key or a merchant endpoint.
